clusters.mechanism: statusDetailSchema strips run.merged and explainStatus never checks it, so a confirmed-merged run is reported as unknown, review needed, or landable instead of Landed.
The digest's awaiting-review predicate ignores review.rounds, so PRs with a queued or running changes round are still listed as awaiting review.

Only PR-opened, round-delivered and approval events seed digest review candidates, so later unread PR events (e.g. pr.ci_passed) after a stale approval never trigger reconciliation and the review is omitted.
The digest's blocked-land branch ignores the handled/merged flag, so a confirmed merged run still shows a blocked-land alert.
The digest makes sequential, unbounded per-run HTTP requests over the whole unacknowledged feed, and the feed is rescanned every session because the digest never acks.
A failed per-run lookup is not handled in the digest, so one error aborts the entire digest output.
quote() does not escape bidi override or zero-width characters in untrusted PR text.
Digest rows have no length cap, so long untrusted titles or questions flood session context.
approvalIsLatest requires a headRefOid match, so a snapshot without headRefOid lets an older failed round override a newer approval.
getRunDetail re-runs the approval query that approvalFor already runs, only to get created_at.
limitless_review over MCP passes no reviewer, so submitReview defaults to "human" and misattributes agent verdicts.
The Codex skill is copied from the Claude skill and tells Codex to use the 'claude' feed consumer, so they share a cursor.
The change is about twice the requested source line budget.
